the-contract-and-its-binding.text: This page reports conformance evidence for the generic registry that cardano-keri consumes, bound to a pinned cardano-keri commit. The canonical identity rows carry the correction epic sixteen executed: a permissionless ledger cannot prohibit a rival registry, so canonical identity is a derivation the consumer authenticates, not a refusal the chain performs.

the-denominator.text: The inventory file carries forty-two rows with forty-one owned. Row CK zero six — bonds, poison, the juvenility window and the signature threshold — is recorded as out of scope: it belongs to cardano-keri's checkpoint machine, and is never claimed here.

The word executed never appears in the inventory file itself; a row prints as executed only when a run receipt for it exists and matches the current commit. Superseded and held rows stay in the denominator: relabelling a row pays no coverage and shrinks no board.

the-generic-registry-rows.text: This section preserves historical observations from the earlier source revisions named in the report. Its old schema, parameter counts, accepting paths and pending repair descriptions are not current candidate evidence. Read the current ownerless integration section for the present contract.

One cage, one key, four rows in order. Update folds and the new value reads back from the chain. Delete folds and the key proves absent. Re-insert folds and the third value reads back. Insert on the occupied key is refused by the state script, and a fresh cage accepting a valid insert proves the refusal discriminates.

Every accepting row carries a deliberately wrong variant the run requires to fail, and every refusal is attributed to the script that produced it. Had the chain accepted the occupied insert, that would be a finding, never relabelled as a refusal.

Eleven rows, three dispositions that must never be mistaken for one another. Held: executed, and the consumer requirement is unmet — the empty fold, the surplus action, the crossed refunds. Resolved by ruling: defect evidence of the outstanding owner gate. Superseded: observations kept, claims withdrawn, no execution credit. The run ends non-zero while anything is held — never a pass.

The permissionless fold row was refused by the unrepaired candidate and accepted after the repair, both by execution, at two clean tips, with the owner-signed control beside it. The receipts cited are the ship run taken fresh at the clean tip after the receipt repair, every held row carrying its transaction id and measurements.

A designation split publishes the canonical seed. The first row boots the canonical registry and matches its token name against the SHA two fifty-six of the published seed's reference, recomputed locally. A second row initializes a rival registry from a second seed through the same bootstrap path.

The ledger accepts that rival — the acceptance is the finding, and it is asserted from the chain: both names read back and differ, and the canonical registry is untouched. The consumer's authentication rejects the rival on the derived name while accepting the canonical registry.

A control authenticator that checks only policy and address accepts the rival, which is what makes the rejection attributable to the name alone. The identity rows also derive the applied address from the pinned unapplied hash and one declared parameter, and forge an output at the canonical address with no token: the ledger accepts it and no script executed.

One fresh cage per row: submitted datum bytes read back identical, one executing witness per spending redeemer constructor, a wrong constructor index refused by both cage scripts, request and mint constructors covered with the unreachable migration recorded, and the six-field token state round-tripped with the stake credential absent and present.

Every accepting row carries a skipped or corrupted variant the run requires to fail. The six-field state schema is named pending epic seventeen's ownerless repair: the expectation is superseded at that repair and the row will be re-executed against the repaired blueprint.

Branch and leaf proofs ride accepted folds, but no accepted fold has ever carried a fork, and two independently ground fork proofs verified by the Haskell stack are refused by the compiled validator with a bare machine error. The row carries no receipt and stays uncovered.
The full bundle of keys, shapes, both verdicts and the refusal bytes is filed as a user story escalation, and the offline oracle reproduces every offline claim without a node.

Ship runs on clean trees with cardano-node ten point seven. Maxima are queried from the running node, never hardcoded. Execution units stay under three point eight percent for every row, and the forged payment reports zeros honestly because no script purpose exists to evaluate.

Serialized size is the tight dimension: about seventy percent of the transaction maximum for folds, about half for boots. The canonical session records its worst case in its CL zero one receipt; the issue seventy session's CL zero one cannot close while a superseded row carries no receipt, so its worst cases live in the row receipts.
The serialization ship run names its own base with a clean tree. Its worst cases live in the row receipts: datum, witness and state folds beside the generic ones, size still the tight dimension.

Four rows rest on predecessor runs and are cited, not re-executed, and a fifth is superseded with its observation preserved and no credit. The consumer-gap rows are executed holds now: the requirement stays unmet, and a held row is never a pass. The serialization schema rows await the ownerless repair before fresh execution, because coverage is not inherited across a wire-format change.
The identity rows do not evidence the serialization boundary, constructor coverage or batch limits. Single-request devnet folds say nothing about other environments.

Row CS zero seven is unmarked with a finding, never a gap and never a pass. The migrating constructor is recorded unreachable with its validator-read reason. Refusal reasons keep every failing script hash in ledger order.

current-ownerless-integration.text: The current state has six fields: root, maximum fee, process time, retract time, representative policy and consumer pin. The state has zero parameters; the request keeps two ordered parameters. Address derivation compares the production result with the actual chain address, and an extra application must fail the same comparison. This is an off-chain identity check.

Spending and minting constructor rows remain partial where End, Sweep, Burning and Migrating lack complete witnesses. Each residual stays inside its receipt. Missing accounting is incomplete, and free refusal text earns no constructor credit. The generic observation rows stay held. The diagram connects bound execution receipts to complete evidence, partial constructors or held requirements; both partial and held outcomes retain strict completion debt.

The inventory retains forty-two rows and forty-one owned. The protected population stays one hundred ninety-six, with both implementation layers and all recorded debt. Fork correspondence and Blaster work remain with epic eighteen. The connected naming release does not close those obligations.

current-replay-commands.text: Build the current blueprint and use a fresh receipt directory outside the tracked tree for each session. Run ten generic rows, five canonical identity rows, then five serialization devnet rows and two local checks. Superseded rows remain in the inventory but are not runtime commands.

The generic session must end with exactly the three held rows, the identity session must succeed, and the serialization session must show its two partial rows. A nonzero exit alone proves nothing: inspect exact identities, source binding, verdicts, residuals and controls. An armed control must reach its intended assertion; an ordinary partial exit is not a control failure.
